text:
Lina (Design): dropped a tiny prototype -> https://www.figma.com/file/snack/onboard-snackpack 
Lina (Design): concept: a "starter snackpack" — single inline card tailored to the repo with three micro-actions (Try, View, Configure). keeps the banner minimal.
Marcus (PM): love the low-commitment vibe. primary goal = faster time-to-first-sample. what if detection misfires?
Lina (Design): add a dismissible line: 'Not relevant? Browse all samples' + small 'why this?' help link. also a subtle privacy note.
Elliot (Frontend): implementation note: detection runs in-browser against top-level files; show skeleton card immediately and replace when result ready. no network needed unless they pick a starter.
Sam (DevEx): flag: replacing the card after load must not cause layout jump. reserve card height and fade replace.
Jo (A11y): a11y concern: dynamic replace needs sr announcement. propose aria-live="polite" and a sr-only message "Starter suggestions ready".
Lina (Design): copy options for the micro-actions: primary CTA = 'Try this', secondary = 'See alternatives', tertiary = 'Configure'. thoughts?
Marcus (PM): prefer 'Try this' for lower friction. add tiny risk tag: 'Low setup' or 'Requires secrets' so users know commitment.
Elliot (Frontend): can compute a simple category: if manifest has build scripts -> 'Standard'; if needs env -> 'Requires secrets'. keep tags simple text.
Jo (A11y): ensure tags are text (not only color). also check contrast for small tags in dark mode.
Sam (DevEx): privacy copy draft: 'We scan filenames in your browser to suggest starters. Nothing leaves your machine unless you select a starter.' legal ok?
Marcus (PM): short variant for UI: 'We analyze repo filenames locally to suggest starters.' full explanation on docs link.
Lina (Design): visual tweak: add an inline time-estimate chip: 'Quick (<5m)' or 'Setup (~15m)'. small tooltip: 'Estimate varies by machine.'
Elliot (Frontend): runtime estimate is heuristic; label it clearly as estimate. for monorepos, show a small path hint like 'pkg/server'.
Jo (A11y): when user toggles path or alternatives, ensure aria-pressed on toggles and focus moves predictably. do not steal focus for auto-detect.
Sam (DevEx): session behavior: user can 'Hide suggestions' for session; opt into 'Always personalize' stored in profile. store minimal flags only.
Marcus (PM): metrics: fire snackpack_shown, snackpack_tried, snackpack_skipped. keep events anonymous by default.
Lina (Design): edge case: false positives (e.g., repo with many languages) -> show multi-match pill: 'Matches: JS, Go' and allow manual pick.
Elliot (Frontend): UI will show up to 2 suggestions, plus 'More' overflow. clicking 'More' opens full samples catalogue.
Jo (A11y): preflight checklist: 1) aria-live on container, 2) sr-only status message, 3) keyboard order + focus after user-initiated replace, 4) contrast checks for chips.
Sam (DevEx): we'll keep detection lightweight: filenames + manifest heuristics. no file content parsing. good for privacy and perf.
Lina (Design): I'll iterate copy and add the 'why this?' modal content for the help link. will post updated figma by EOD. anyone want to pair on SR walkthrough?
Elliot (Frontend): I can pair tomorrow AM. will spike parser and push branch.
Marcus (PM): great. I'll file a tiny ticket for privacy copy sign-off and the metric events.
onboard-bot: Preview for feature/snackpack-inline -> https://preview.redwood.ai/snackpack (staging)
Lina (Design): thanks all :sparkles: will ping when mocks are updated.
